verdict.rationale: OpenClaw documents a built-in `exec` tool that runs shell commands in the workspace. The docs call it a mutating shell surface that can create, edit, or delete files wherever the host or sandbox filesystem permits, with stdin modes and TTY support, plus optional sandbox backends. Hands-on community reports corroborate a real exec surface: one user had it set up a VM and configure Prometheus and Grafana, and another notes it has full access by default. Missing for 10: no evidence of a dedicated structured file-edit/patch tool beyond shell-based edits.
